quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection. You do not always need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Watch for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic lights. It tells left-turning drivers that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left at a green light that they must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road meets a divided highway.
You are driving on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road meets a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads separated by a median.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means that turning right is not allowed.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are ordered:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top as: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down, then swings it down to their side, following riders should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. You should slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs warn you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Yield to other drivers or pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the rules you must follow. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This is a:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right, then left ahead. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the upcoming divider.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is roadwork ahead. Turn right to detour.
The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp turn. Slow down before the turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you will drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions when turn signals do not work. A left arm extended straight out to the left means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn drivers about work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and make sure the road is clear before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right of a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers to be careful about road conditions that may cause slippery driving when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign with black markings on a white background. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate lanes going in opposite directions with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a steep hill or downgrade coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
This lane is for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that controls how traffic moves. It means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow pointing downward, it tells other drivers that you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They warn drivers of dangers ahead. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A sign with a red circle and red line through it means something is prohibited. When you see this sign, you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider holds their left arm out straight with palm up and then swings their arm upward, it tells the group to go faster.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and give the right-of-way to others.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and give the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and give the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangle sign means yield. Slow down when you see it and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you continue.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Some turns are only allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge safely together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. This lane is reserved for buses and vehicles with the driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
Another road is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to turn either right or left.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it tells the group to stop.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped warning signs only warn of no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe. This helps vehicles enter the roadway smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead can fit only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign forbids U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to become one. Be prepared to merge.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic before proceeding.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. A left arm bent at the elbow pointing upward means the rider plans to turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming. Be ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign orders you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign warns you that the lane you are in will end soon. Be ready to merge with other traffic safely.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does the lead rider mean by raising their left arm and pointing one finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, it tells the group to line up in a single-file formation.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive with extra caution through the work zone.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can continue through or exit the freeway from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane does not continue through the interchange. Instead, it leads to an exit ramp. You can change lanes to go through, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully because pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The road crosses railroad tracks at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves to the right, then to the left.
The road curves to the left, then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves to the right, then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road will curve right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show rules that drivers must obey. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road hazards. This sign warns that the area has low overhead clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter at low speed and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. This sign warns that wet pavement can be slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes especially slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the car in front of you.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that vehicles will be entering the road from the right side.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will aim the wrong way because one side of your car is higher.
A tire may be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if the shoulder has water on it.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops off onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep downhill. Adjust your speed to prevent brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the highest legal speed for that road in good conditions. You may need to go slower if conditions are poor.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are merging.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people in the crosswalk and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals have red on top and green on the bottom. When arranged sideways, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. There may be more signs like this through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow backgrounds. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to prepare for a steep hill and adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says U-turns are not allowed.
